mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notification (user_id, actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, post_id, content_snippet, is_read) VALUES (#{userId}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{postId}, #{contentSnippet}, #{isRead})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notification SET is_read = 1, read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
